title: [gym] Incorrect Message About Stored Archive
body:
### New Issue Checklist
- [x] Updated fastlane to the latest version
- [x] I have read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
### Issue Description

When a user specifies their own archive path like: 

``` ruby
gym(scheme: "Acme", configuration: "Debug", include_symbols: true, clean: true, archive_path: "ios-build-dev/", output_directory: "ios-build-dev/")
```

The output displays:

``` sh
[12:28:03]: Successfully stored the archive. You can find it in the Xcode Organizer.
```

However the archive is actually not stored in the Xcode Organizer because I specified an archive path parameter.

The solution would be to either:
1. Also store the archive in the Organizer
2. Add a flag that allows the user to set to also store the archive in the organizer
3. Remove the message when the archive path is specified.
##### Complete output when running fastlane, including the stack trace and command used

```
[12:28:03]: ▸ Archive Succeeded
[12:28:03]: Successfully stored the archive. You can find it in the Xcode Organizer.
[12:28:03]: $ /usr/bin/xcrun /Users/bob/Documents/Work/AcmeCorp/Acme/AcmeiOS/vendor/bundle/ruby/2.0.0/bundler/gems/fastlane-55dbe9ea0102/gym/lib/assets/wrap_xcodebuild/xcbuild-safe.sh -exportArchive -exportOptionsPlist '/var/folders/c1/k7hp99v16tv94f996yycplkr0000gp/T/gym_config20160405-31564-jo63pd.plist' -archivePath 'ios-build-release/.xcarchive.xcarchive' -exportPath '/var/folders/c1/k7hp99v16tv94f996yycplkr0000gp/T/gym_output20160405-31564-uemkka' 
[12:28:53]: Compressing 22 dSYM(s)
[12:28:53]: $ cd '/Users/bob/Documents/Work/AcmeCorp/Acme/AcmeiOS/ios-build-release/.xcarchive.xcarchive/dSYMs' && zip -r '/Users/bob/Documents/Work/AcmeCorp/Acme/AcmeiOS/ios-build-release/Acme.app.dSYM.zip' *.dSYM
```

Please copy the complete content of your `Fastfile` and any other configuration files you use below:

``` ruby

# update_fastlane

# This is the minimum version number required.
# Update this, if you use features of a newer version

default_platform :ios

platform :ios do

        ENV["MATCH_GIT_URL"] =  "git@gitlab.acmecorp.com:acmecorp/apple-certificates.git"
        ENV['FASTLANE_TEAM_ID'] = 'AAAAAAA'

            ENV['FASTLANE_USER'] = 'appleid@acmecorp.com'
        end

        ENV['MATCH_USERNAME'] = ENV['FASTLANE_USER']
        ENV['DELIVER_USERNAME'] = ENV['FASTLANE_USER']
        ENV['PILOT_USERNAME'] = ENV['FASTLANE_USER']

        if is_ci?
            unlock_keychain
        end
    end

    desc "Runs all the tests"
        lane :test do
        type_certificates(type: 'development')
        Actions.sh('bundle exec pod repo update')
        cocoapods
        gym(scheme: "Acme", configuration: "Debug", include_symbols: true, clean: true, archive_path: "ios-build-dev/", output_directory: "ios-build-dev/")
        gym(scheme: "Acme tvOS", destination: "generic/platform=tvOS", include_symbols: true, configuration: "Debug", archive_path: "tvos-build-dev/", output_directory: "tvos-build-dev/")
    end

    desc "Submits a new Beta Build to Apple TestFlight"
    lane :deploy do
        Actions.sh('bundle exec pod repo update')
        cocoapods

        # Increment build number
        increment_build_number

        # Set version number to the one at the top of the CHANGELOG
        readme = File.read("../CHANGELOG.md")
        latest_version = readme.split("\n## ").first
        first_line = latest_version.split("\n").first
        version_number = first_line.split(" ")[1]

        increment_version_number(version_number: version_number)

        clean_build_artifacts

        # Tag release and push to GitHub
        commit_version_bump(message: "[ci skip] Deploying build version #{lane_context[SharedValues::BUILD_NUMBER]} and main version #{version_number}", xcodeproj: 'Acme.xcodeproj')
        push_to_git_remote

        type_certificates(type: 'appstore')

        # Generate release notes from CHANGELOG
        release_notes = latest_version.split("\n")[1..-1].join("\n")

        gym(scheme: "Acme", configuration: "Release", include_symbols: true, archive_path: "ios-build-release/", output_directory: "ios-build-release/")
        pilot(changelog: release_notes)

        gym(scheme: "Acme tvOS", destination: "generic/platform=tvOS", configuration: "Release", archive_path: "tvos-build-release/", output_directory: "tvos-build-release/")
        pilot(changelog: release_notes)

    end

    lane :certificates do
        type_certificates(type: 'appstore')
        type_certificates(type: 'development')
    end

    private_lane :type_certificates do |options|
        ENV['MATCH_TYPE'] = options[:type]
        match(app_identifier: "com.acmecorp.Acme.watchkitextension")
        match(app_identifier: "com.acmecorp.Acme.AcmeTodayExtension")
        match(app_identifier: "com.acmecorp.Acme.watchkitapp")
        match(app_identifier: "com.acmecorp.Acme.watchkitapp.watchkitextension")
        match(app_identifier: "com.acmecorp.Acme")
        match(app_identifier: "com.acmecorp.Acme", platform: "tvos")
    end


    lane :screenshots do
        snapshot(
        nobuild: false, # Skip building and use a pre-built .app under your 'build_dir'
        noclean: false, # Skip cleaning
        verbose: true, # Show output of UIAutomation
        snapshot_file_path: './fastlane' # Specify a path to the directory containing the Snapfile
        )
        sh "cp -R ./watchscreenshots/* ./screenshots/en-US"
    end

    lane :refresh_dsyms do
        download_dsyms                  # Download dSYM files from iTC
        upload_symbols_to_crashlytics   # Upload them to Crashlytics
        clean_build_artifacts           # Delete the local dSYM files
    end

    # You can define as many lanes as you want

    after_all do |lane|
    # This block is called, only if the executed lane was successful

    # slack(
    #   message: "Successfully deployed new App Update."
    # )
    end


    error do |lane, exception|
    # slack(
    #   message: exception.message,
    #   success: false
    # )
    end
end


# More information about multiple platforms in fastlane:
# https://github.com/KrauseFx/fastlane/blob/master/docs/Platforms.md
```
### Environment

fastlane version (fastlane -v): fastlane 1.80.0
Do you use bundler, rbenv or rvm?
yes
